verdict.rationale: Solid documents fine-grained reactivity where only dependent code reruns, built-in Context/Stores for global state, and TypeScript/Vite integration. A user reports staying happy with it on a 'largish' product for over a year, and benchmarks show it among the fastest frameworks. Scale-related maintainability is only thinly evidenced, though: one hands-on critique reports alpha-quality dev tools, lacking docs, and very slow Suspense/SolidStart routing, and others note ecosystem gaps. Missing for 10: first-party guidance on structuring large codebases and team workflows, mature dev tooling, independent evidence of performance holding in large multi-team apps, and resolution of the reported Suspense/routing slowness.
